profile_text.body:
Credo AI is an AI governance company founded in 2020, offering a platform designed to help enterprises discover, monitor, and govern AI systems across models, agents, and applications. The company describes itself as having created the AI governance category, and its platform centers on a Knowledge Graph that combines regulatory intelligence with business context, supported by what the site calls forward-deployed experts and more than 300 integrations. Core functions include centralized AI inventory, policy enforcement, risk management, and audit-ready compliance documentation.

The company's primary product, also called Credo AI, is a purpose-built governance platform that covers model-level, application-level, and agent-level oversight within a single interface. It includes pre-built policy packs for frameworks such as the EU AI Act, NIST AI RMF, and ISO 42001, and features an AI assistant called GAIA (Govern AI Assistant) that the site says compresses weeks of governance work into hours. The site notes collaborations with organizations including Mastercard and IBM, and quotes from several enterprise customers citing faster EU AI Act compliance and improved risk management workflows.

The site reports that Credo AI is ranked No. 6 in Applied AI on Fast Company's World's Most Innovative Companies of 2026 list, alongside Google, Nvidia, OpenAI, and Anthropic. The held facts on this site confirm the company has an active profile and list the Credo AI platform in the AI Governance and Risk Management Platforms category, with notes citing its clean interface and fast deployment. No litigation, patent filings, or SEC records are held for the company at this time.
